verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every PR and posts a review summary on it. That summary has a confidence score, a short verdict and a severity-sorted findings list, and each PR also gets generated sequence diagrams and flowcharts to help readers parse complex changes. Together these give human reviewers a fast way to get oriented. Missing for 10: an explicit narrative summary of what changed or a file-by-file change walkthrough (the documented summary is review-findings oriented), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the summary and diagrams.
